76740.body:
THE NEWSLETTER 

Автор: Volkswagen Group


Автор: Volkswagen Group

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/july-journal-electric-mobility-innovation-results-volkswagen-group-fka1e?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3Bqxl5frkgRLSbYCMMxcHFoQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=27PfDIE_i84Io1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~ms8nsq6f~dd-null-null&eid=fz96fz-ms8nsq6f-dd
  
Welcome to our July newsletter! This month, we take a look at the latest developments across the Volkswagen Group, from electric mobility and software innovation to future technologies and business results. From the world premiere of the Volkswagen ID. Cross, completing the Electric Urban Car Family, to new software capabilities powering our latest electric vehicles, July demonstrates how the Group is making advanced mobility accessible to more customers. At the same time, progress in autonomous driving, sustainable manufacturing and our battery ecosystem showcases the breadth of innovation across the Group. We also share updates on our latest delivery figures and half-year results. 🔍 Explore the 8️⃣ highlights that shaped this month: 🎉 1. World Premiere: ID. Cross The new Volkswagen ID. Cross celebrates its world premiere, completing the Electric Urban Car Family. 🗨️ Oliver Blume, CEO Volkswagen Group: "Four models, three brands, one platform: with the ID. Polo, the CUPRA Raval, the Škoda Epiq and the ID. Cross, Volkswagen Group is bringing individuality, quality and advanced technology to affordable electric mobility - without compromise." The strong customer response already shows the appeal of this concept: more than 54,000 orders have been received for the Electric Urban Car Family before all four models have even reached customers. 💻 2. Software Facts across the Electric Urban Car Family The Volkswagen Group's Electric Urban Car Family combines affordable electric mobility with a new software generation. Across models such as the CUPRA Raval, Volkswagen ID. Polo, Škoda Auto Epiq, and the Volkswagen ID. Cross, drivers benefit from features like Digital Key, next-generation Travel Assist, Android-based infotainment, connected vehicle services, and unique digital experiences tailored to everyday mobility. 🚗 3. Gen.Urban - Driving Experience in Urban Areas Volkswagen Group Innovation's self-driving research vehicle Gen.Urban has been collecting insights into future shared mobility in real-world traffic since the end of 2025. The project explores how passengers experience autonomous driving, which digital features best support work, entertainment, and relaxation and how-vehicle-passenger interaction should be designed. 🎨 4. Bentley's Dream Factory reaches new milestone With the opening of its new state-of-the-art Paint

The 50K UPX pack sold out on July 29, the day it launched. Only a few 20K UPX packs remained as of Thursday morning, July 30. If they are gone by the time you read this, the Market is still open, and Level 3 and higher Uppies are the ones that matter right now.

BROWSE UPPIES ON THE MARKET
(https://promo.upland.me/e3t/Ctc/I7+113/d2lvlb04/VX1h-k8MMy82W6Yjr4J6wLkfkW7TctdS5S6ggjN8rPF4T3l5QzW69sMD-6lZ3lMW8F16zf2gFTJ6W860qXh64rYDxW5RQfxF35_pBrW7YBSVK7YZ7YlW7ZZQqn7kMBFcW7HvgxN3yVB8LN5mqDGMRQTfzN7zQ0jLP1pHLVfp8T_4KsZHBW83HxCL8m8gMnN6-qD8ZS9T9nW8-thhP5NVFC7W1HLSSN3WpBHnW6PpP8C7l2hJNW9lTFgJ462gp_W35Xn7t8xXwf3W6ckPQ58Y5dNqN2PCn7FBw8wZW6mKrS38QK8-7W4vJ37C2ZS2ZdcN8gn04 )

Your Uppies are about to get a job

During Sizzle Season, which runs August 1 through September 15, 2026, you will be able to assign Uppies to your properties. At launch, Level 3 and higher Uppies are eligible. Once assigned, an Uppie acts as a caretaker, handling the petting for the plants on that property to help maintain their wellbeing. You still feed your plants. Your Uppie covers the ongoing petting.

This is the start of property-level Uppie utility, not the end of it. Later releases add Uppies appearing and moving in 3D on the map, Uppie employment at eligible structures, and automated Trove collection. Level 5 and higher Uppies will automatically collect Troves from plants in a later release, with higher-level Uppies collecting more each day. Where you assign them will matter. What you build there will matter.

And Troves, Banking, and Progression are confirmed before Harvest Season begins on October 1, 2026

Collect Troves through gameplay from plants, structures, and recipes. Bank them permanently into your Trove Vault and climb Banking levels. Progress through a new Upland Progression level by banking Troves, developing your portfolio, and completing objectives.

Caption: 

# Thursday links: crypto PMF, PM PMF, eBay shocker, Pokémon perps, the price of trust, DATs

[Crypto has 50% of the scam market](https://consumerfed.org/news/press-releases/americans-lost-an-estimated-148-billion-to-online-scams-crimes-in-2025-up-nearly-26-from-2024-1009-per-household-average/)

The Consumer Federation of America (CFA) estimates that Americans lost $148 billion to online scams and crime in 2025, up 26% from 2024. More than half of the losses — $80.7 billion — are thought to have involved cryptocurrency.

The CFA gets to those numbers by using a multiplier based on the DOJ’s estimate that only 14% of financial crimes are typically reported. $20.8 billion of losses were reported to law enforcement in 2025. 7.1x that number is $148 billion. 

“This is the conservative choice,” the report says. “Some studies report rates as low as 4-5%, implying multipliers of 20-25x.”

Using a 25x multiplier would put total losses at roughly $520 billion. Yikes.

==“This crisis demands additional bold action through legislation, enforcement, and public education at every level,” the report concludes.==

==It also hints at a preventative measure we can take right now: Stop using Facebook. Facebook is the venue for an ==[estimated](https://bbbmarketplacetrust.org/riskreport2024/)== 57% of all online scams.==

==That might just be because Facebook is where we spend most of our scrolling time. But a ====_Wall Street Journal_==== ==[report](https://www.wsj.com/tech/meta-fraud-facebook-instagram-813363c8)== puts at least some of the blame on lax oversight: Facebook allows suspicious advertisers to rack up as many as 32 automated “strikes” for financial fraud before it bans their accounts.==

==_32 strikes and you’re out!_==

==A final statistic suggests next year’s report could be even uglier. The CFA’s new category of AI-enabled fraud accounted for $6.3 billion in losses.==
